releases.displayName: October 6 Patch Notes - Shoves & Steals Tuning

items.text: [p align="start"]We’ve rolled out a small patch update this morning with some bug fixes and a few gameplay improvements. There will be no downtime for this patch update.
[p align="start"]
Fixed an issue with the wrong belt on the victory screen in KO Solos
Fixed an issue where the “Wins” leaderboard ticker does not display the user’s true rank placement in either Leaderboard
Fixed an issue where Leaderboard ticker arrows were inconsistent when ranking up or down in the leaderboards
Fixed an issue in Post-Match when the camera could swing unnaturally while bringing up stats
Fixed an issue in the Victory Screen where some player would walk into the crowd
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/56e58217eb1618ca47c7bed512a47e4ae02d5910.png"]
Shoves have been nerfed, now with a higher energy cost and a lower shove radius
Most players’ shove ratings have been lowered significantly
Steals have been made less effective. The stealer slows down more when attempting a steal and the steal radius has been reduced for steals and lane steals
The speed of the player movement has been reduced slightly
Ja Morant had his crown on dunks restored and was given more power
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Additional information will be shared in our Discord server at Discord.gg/NBATHERUN.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/954282a353d2c3bd5aeca535f8ba324721aeb0dc.png"]
Let's RUN!

releases.displayName: Legends are Live! Wave One 2000s Legends Patch Notes

items.text: Wave One - 2000s Legends is LIVE. Our first Season is underway, the leaderboards have been reset, and it’s time to dominate. This is our biggest update yet, packed with community-requested features, new ways to play, and plenty of new heat to hit the court with and play your way.

Now it’s your turn to get buckets. Drop your nastiest plays, biggest dimes and cold-blooded game winners. Keep running it back, keep showing us what you’ve got, and keep helping shape where NBA THE RUN goes next.
Notable Additions

notes.title: New Players: 2000s Legends added to the Shop

items.text: Allen Iverson
Vince Carter
Tracy McGrady
Dirk Nowitzki
Kevin Garnett
Two Championship Belts added, one each for Knockout Squads and Knockout Solos
Earned on a per player basis per mode, can you collect ‘em all?
Evolving Trophy System added - the more ‘chips you win, the more your trophy will evolve from gold to galactic (total lifetime trophy count for tourney wins)
2 new modes added: Practice Mode and Custom Match
Pick any map & ruleset to go up against AI in Practice or friends in Customs
There are no CRED and level progression rewards for these modes

Drive Cam - An elevated, end-to-end gameplay camera that follows the action from behind the offense, providing excellent visibility of the basket, player spacing, and passing lanes. Overhead cam goes up with you on offense and remains fixed
Drive Flip Cam - It flips 180 degrees when possession changes, ensuring players are always moving toward the top of the screen.
New Courts
Dyckman (Day & Tournament)
Spring Garden Elementary (Day)

Refactored shoves and forward tricks for characters with a lower Power Rating. Previously they struggled to successfully shove character at or around their level. On the extreme other side players with a high Power Rating never lost a shove. Shove and Forward Trick are now valid choices for less powerful characters, and no longer unstoppable with higher characters.

releases.displayName: NBA THE RUN - Wave One 2000s Legends Update

items.text: The Legends are pulling up next week Tuesday, Sept 29 for our biggest update since launch, Wave One – 2000s Legends. Our first seasonal update of content is free for all players headlined by five NBA Legends that’ll have players re-thinking their starting squads.
You might want to take another look at the Legends Gameplay Trailer that was just released. There’s a lot in this update we can’t wait for you to get your hands on.

notes.title: Here’s the intel you need to know

items.text: The Legends Are Ready to Show Out and Wreak Havoc on Lineups
NBA Legends and Hall of Famers arrive including Allen Iverson, Kevin Garnett, Vince Carter, Dirk Nowitzki and Tracy McGrady with unique gameplay animations and alternate uniforms
Unlock each Legend in-game for 5K CRED each OR purchase them as DLC for $9.99 to get all 5 Legends at once
Legends Ratings were revealed and showed many players may need to re-think their top 3v3 lineup
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/f697d8152d9f3f0846ef577f25c208ca6cfb6eb4.png"]
Leave Your Mark With the new Championship Belt
Earn a Championship Belt with each player, giving you another way to show true mastery across the roster
Earn the strap with every baller in Squads & Solos… Can you collect them all and be the GOAT of THE RUN?
Drive Camera arrives with Two Additional Cam Options
Drive Cam & Drive Flip Cam have been added to the game for a more modern in-game feel with “down the court” action giving players a whole new way to experience the game
Drive Cam looks towards the basket you are shooting on from behind your player
Drive Flip Cam looks towards the basket you are shooting on offense and flips to look at the basket you are defending
Read lanes better, solidify your defensive strategy, get a clearer look on how open you are on shot attempts… The new camera opens up the court!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/fcae52a12ccf6aea48ac6a607b6e6e36b51177ac.png"]
Practice Mode and Custom Matches Help Hone Your Game
Practice Mode arrives, giving you a place to get reps in your own way. It’s a single game vs the CPU with the court and ruleset of your choosing on Knockout Squads or Knockout Solos mode
Custom Matches take it a step further by allowing you to invite up to 5 Friends online in Squads to practice with or against you
We’re talking about practice – Experiment with different setups before jumping into the competition as matches in these modes won’t earn CRED or affect progression
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/cb15a514728a3f10cc7d1e6dfda88d9c2b855bb8.png"]
New Courts: Dyckman (Day + Tournament variants) + Spring Garden Elementary (Day variant)

Both a daytime and nighttime version of the famous Dyckman Court are coming to NBA THE RUN, showing some love to NY, city of the newest NBA Champions and where many of streetball’s greatest courts live
Previously available only in Shootaround, the Spring Garden Elementary (Day) rooftop court has been added into the Knockout Tournament map playlist.
Gameplay Improvements

The team also touched on a number of gameplay changes and improvements in the works including a significant goaltending nerf, player changes (see below), and more advanced off-the-heezy animations – including situations where defenders can get hit multiple times or even get dropped
There’s more to unpack here, including new driving layups, standing dunks, alley-oops and more, and we’ll be taking a deeper look at these gameplay changes later this week
Notable Player Updates
A number of players are also getting attention, including Stephen Curry, Jayson Tatum, LaMelo Ball, Kawhi Leonard, Bam Adebayo and Cooper Flagg
Street Legends also got buffs including Spin Cycle, Shen Tong and DJ
The Rookie Class has seen their stats ticked down a little bit
We’ll have the breakdown in the Patch Notes
More Vibes and Expression + Licensed Music Arrives
New Taunts, Advanced Dunks, Banners, Badges and Alternate Jerseys are coming to the Shop.
Licensed music is also on the way to NBA THE RUN with a few options to curate your soundspace
Leaderboards will be resetting on the same day of the update Sept. 29. We’re looking forward to seeing who ends up in the Top 5 before the update.
There’s much more to reveal in this first wave including a few more surprises, so we’ll be providing comprehensive Patch Notes before the update hits.
Make sure you stay locked in by joining our socials on X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
Wave One is almost here.

releases.displayName: August Game Update: Leaderboards, Player Updates, Tuning and More Available Now

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/d0c5ba3eb0a548ecd9bea7af06305b144ff6d769.png"]

Today, we're launching a game update that adds new content like Leaderboards, an Emoji Wheel and updated fits for players who've moved teams, as well as continued tuning and fixes. In September, we'll be launching our first full season, including NBA Legends, Drive Camera, and more.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/96f5568afd22a05450540c1f988d45ba6fa3a146.png"]

notes.title: The August game update is available now, including

items.text: Leaderboards: This was originally a stretch goal for us, so we’re really excited to deliver it today. Players can now compare their performance against the world’s very best - or against friends - across KO Squads and Solos in virtually every major stat, including wins, win percentage, trophies, blocks, dunks, 3-pointers, and more. This is a new era for competition. While your all-time stats remain intact, Leaderboards start fresh today and everyone starts on equal footing. We'll perform another leaderboard reset when our first official season begins and continue evolving the feature to ensure it best recognizes the top players in NBA THE RUN. Can you climb into the top 3 and see your name in the bronze, silver or even gold position? Prove it if you’re truly one of NBA THE RUN’s GOATs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/cf5e64c0b8643a3fb4f23ced0f437c4e9efc15bd.png"]

Player Roster Changes on their new teams: LeBron James, Giannis Antetokounmpo, LaMelo Ball, Ja Morant and Jaylen Brown will all have their new teams’ jerseys. Additionally, Anthony Edwards will also be sporting the new Timberwolves jersey and Devin Booker has been updated with his new number. We’ve also kept each player’s previous team jerseys available, so if you want to run with LeBron on the Lakers or Giannis on the Bucks, the choice is yours. More jersey variants will continue to be purchasable in the Shop with CRED earned through play, just like other alternate jerseys.

Updated Player Ratings: We’re updating player ratings and In the Zone abilities for a few players on new teams and the rookie players for balance. See the details in the patch notes coming at release.

Emoji Wheel: Quickly communicate with your Crew teammates from the main menu lobby using a variety of emojis. Coordinate your next match by letting teammates know you're ready to run it back, need a quick break, are leaving the Crew, or simply show your team how you’re feeling!
New Gameplay Animations for blocking dunks, rebounded putback dunks, enhanced blocks and a rework of Darryn Peterson’s Advanced Spin move.

Gameplay balance and tuning - We’ve made a substantial tuning pass to improve overall balance and reward skillful play. Things we’ve adjusted include goaltending, steals, interceptions, rebounding, blocks, dunk consistency, In The Zone, and several other core mechanics. We'll share the full breakdown in the patch notes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/42a62e6e12ad926e9deaf40547128f5c71e1c1dc.png"]

In September, we're unleashing our first season. We’re tackling a lot of content and have put in the work to ensure the new additions (including some surprises) aren’t watering down the experience. We appreciate everyone’s patience as we’re anticipating this season to be even bigger than expected.

5 NBA Legends - Each with unique player animations and likeness built from the ground up, these five new players will give you even more options to build a versatile championship squad. These Hall of Famers also know a thing or two about buzzer beaters. We can’t wait to see how they fit into your lineup and game-winning highlights.

Drive Camera - Another highly-anticipated ask, this new camera angle gives players the option to see further down the court in a more modern in-game feel. Get that fast break started early and improve your squad’s ball movement from end to end. We’re looking forward to this option to help players find their teammates better.

Practice Mode - This new, non-PvP, non-tournament mode enables players to learn the game at their own pace. Choose your ruleset, select your court and play solo against the AI or go online with friends. Assemble your best builds and practice on each ruleset to strengthen chemistry with your Squad before jumping into competitive RUNs. No rewards, stat tracking, or Career progression are earned in this mode.

And That’s Not All: The Championship Belt is coming which allows players to showcase the specific ballers they’ve won Championships with. It’ll evolve throughout the season. There will also be a new Bracket Busting celebration that will be showcased when you’ve beat someone else in their Finals.

New ruleset ‘All The Fire’ is getting closer to making its debut. And known as the “red carpet of streetball”, Dyckman Park in NYC will be added as our new court w/ daytime and nighttime variants. This is all in addition to new Shop items including new dunks and taunts.

As we’ve said before, we’re committed to continuing evolving NBA THE RUN with your feedback, so we’d love to continue hearing from you on the new additions coming tomorrow alongside the patch notes. We're already mapping out plans for our next Season as well as bigger ticket features coming later in our roadmap.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117598/8512cce913f3728349be979cf02d3e3fe144839b.png"]
Thanks for continuing to build the game with us. Once again we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to share more with you soon on the upcoming features. See you on the courts.

The August Game Update is now live and we’re already seen some familiar names in the community climb up the Leaderboards. We’ve also seen some changes to people’s primary squads with the updated Player Ratings and new jerseys for stars on new teams.
Here’s more details on the improvements and tuning we’ve made to the game based on your feedback to help stay ahead of the competition. Patch notes for today’s release are below:
Player Specific Changes
Added new jerseys for all confirmed traded players w/ default jerseys unlocked
Updated speed and reworked Darryn Peterson left and right advanced tricks
Updated Devin Booker jersey to #15 to reflect latest number for 2026-27 season
Updated Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball’s Timberwolves jersey to reflect 2026-27 season jersey
AJ Dybantsa’s ratings were reduced in 3’s, handles, steals and aura
Darryn Peterson’s ratings were reduced in stamina and handles
Cameron Boozer’s ratings were reduced in stamina, 3’s, and rebound
Giannis Antetokounmpo’s Zone Ability changed to Amped Up
Lebron James’ Zone Ability was changed to Dropping Dimes
LeBron James’ ratings were boosted in stamina, 3’s, handles, steal, aura and reduced in block
Jaylen Brown’s ratings were boosted in 2’s and guard
Gameplay Changes
Extended near hoop dead zone and reduced block jump height boost to reduce goaltending
Limit to players blocking effectiveness when behind the shooter
Made it harder to steal from a player after they pump fake
Angle and reach of Intercept reduced
Reduced speed of stealer
Reduced reach range of stealer
Angle and reach of Intercept reduced
Near immunity from up-close Intercepts extended
Extended ball pick up for a blocked player to give the blocker a better chance to gain possession
AI Bots with a lower block rating will now attempt blocks
AI Bots will no longer spam steals
Increased movement speed boost while In The Zone
Reduced the chances for failing all dunk types across all level of dunkers
Increased jump height of rebounders to give rebounders a chance versus putback dunks
Tuned Progression & XP CRED performance bonuses
Visual Changes
New animations for putback dunks
New block & advanced block animations
User Interface Changes
Added Leaderboards for KO Squads & KO Solos
Added Emoji Wheel to Front End for post-game interactions
Added Simplified Chinese as a Screen / Menu localized text option
Updated Player Nameplate visuals across the game
Fixed formatting issues for all Rulesets so that presentation is now consistent
Stats Updates
Performance bonuses now include additional baller stat data
Audio Updates
Added “call for pass” VO callout
Audio support for Emoji Comms Wheel actions

releases.displayName: July Game Update - Dybantsa, Peterson & Boozer Join NBA THE RUN

items.text: From being the first three to hear their names called at the Draft last month, to must-see debuts at Summer League earlier in July, it’s now time to welcome AJ Dybantsa, Darryn Peterson and Cameron Boozer to NBA THE RUN.
In addition to these outstanding rookies, we’re also continuing to add more improvements and tuning to the game based on your feedback.

As always, we can’t wait to get your feedback to the new players and changes. Please join our Discord to join the community and drop your feedback, and stay tuned to the latest on NBA THE RUN on YouTube, X, Instagram and TikTok.
Let’s RUN with the rookies!

releases.displayName: NBA THE RUN July Game Update - New Rookies, and More Coming July 21

items.text: It’s time to RUN with the rooks!

Coming off their sizzling Summer League debuts, the top 3 picks of this year’s draft, A.J. Dybantsa of the Washington Wizards, Darryn Peterson of the Utah Jazz and Cameron Boozer of the Memphis Grizzlies, are joining NBA THE RUN in our next game update, Tuesday, July 21. Check out a short mixtape to see them in action:
A.J. Dybantsa has the size, athleticism, and complete offensive game to score from anywhere.
Zone Ability - Going Off (increased offensive ratings for shots, dunks, handles, passes).
Darryn Peterson is cool under pressure, with effortless range and smooth handles.
Zone Ability - Deep Threat (reduced distance and guard penalty when shooting)
Cameron Boozer has the rare combination of power, pure shooting and elite court vision.
Zone Ability - Dropping Dimes (increase to passes rating and speed, receiving player gets a boost to their shots rating)

You can unlock each rookie in The Shop for 5000 CRED at rank 25, so get some games in this weekend and fill up your virtual bankrolls. For a sneak peek of how these dynamic rookies play in game, join us for a special preview in our Discord, Friday, July 17 at 3:00 PM PT / 6:00 PM ET.
We’ll also be going over some of the other changes coming in the July update, including:
“Block Party” Ruleset - All blocks -1 from the other team’s score, will be common
All around improved AI behavior
New unique animations for players, alley-oops, putback dunks and more
Bug fixes, polish, gameplay tuning & balancing
More details to come Tuesday morning as the update drops with our patch notes.

One last thing – we know you want to see players who have changed teams in their new fits, we’re on it, though it is not going to be ready for this update. We will share more progress on this and other things we’re working on soon.
See you in Discord on Friday, we’ll open up some servers for KO Devs for some friendly competition after we give you that sneak peek at the July update.
Hope to see you there and as always, thanks for running with us!

releases.displayName: Quick Patch - See you on the Court this Weekend!

items.text: It’s been a busy 72 hours – we’re seeing some impressive win totals, (unconfirmed) reports of players who have already won 70+ chips and some quadruple alley-oops out in the wild!
Yesterday, we deployed a small patch to address some minor issues we had identified right BEFORE launch:
Fixed Quick Resume bug on Xbox & PS5
Added unlockable dunk into The Shop
Improved VFX for Advanced Dunks & Tricks
Improved Audio balance on the Tournament / Trophy Win screen
Updated in-game Audio VO for Enhanced Blocks and Zonebreaker Ruleset
Revised boot sequence w/ balanced audio
Updated tooltips in Matchmaking Screen
Added a Bot icon over gamertags to display when a Bot / AI is playing
Updated PS5 Home Icon w/ Key Art

Needless to say, we’re reading through all of the other feedback since launch right now – we’ll have more to talk about in terms of some of the things you’re asking about in the coming weeks (if not sooner) – more features, tuning and balancing, etc. In fact, we spent some time playing w/ the crew at Kinda Funny yesterday, talking about how launch has been going, what's to come and helping them get that 'chip!
Thanks again for joining us on the journey! Come RUN with us! (And don't be shy, we haven't seen too much flexing out there -- use those taunts and advanced dunks!)
